Name: Auran
Description: Auran was part of the Inhuman race and became part of the primary security force for the Inhumans after the events that led to the fall of the city of Attilan in the New York Harbor Bay. Auran was created by Charles Soule and Pepe Larraz and first appeared in Inhuman issue 7 (2014).
